title: Precision seeder for agricultural robots
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural sowing, and discloses a precision seeder for an agricultural robot. The precision seeder comprises a body and a seeding wheel, wherein thebody is provided with a mounting cavity, and the seeding wheel is arranged in the mounting cavity in a rotating mode. A seed cavity for placing seeds is formed in the body, and the seed cavity is communicated with the mounting cavity. The body is further provided with a seeding channel communicated to the outside of the body, and the seeding channel is communicated to the mounting cavity. The seeding wheel is provided with a seeding hole and an airflow hole, and the seeding hole is communicated with the airflow hole. The body is provided with a suction zone and a blowing zone. In the rotationprocess of the seeding wheel, the airflow hole is alternately communicated with the suction zone and the blowing zone. When the airflow hole is communicated with the suction zone, the seeding hole opposite to the seed cavity absorbs the seeds in the seed cavity; when the airflow hole is in communication with the blowing zone, the seeds on the seeding hole opposite to the seeding channel fall intothe seeding channel. By controlling the speed and the rotating angle of the seeding wheel, precision seeding can be achieved, and the number of seeds seeded by the seeder is consistent, accurate and controllable every time.

title: Harvester operation state identification method and harvester
abstract: The invention provides a harvester operation state identification method and a harvester, and the method comprises the steps of calling the header height of the harvester if the driving speed of the harvester is determined to be greater than 0; if it is determined that the header height is smaller than the height threshold value, determining the operation state of the harvester according to the rotating speed information of the harvester. According to the harvester operation state identification method and the harvester, the running speed, header height and rotating speed information of the harvester are fused and analyzed, the operation state of the harvester is comprehensively judged, identification is more accurate, and a basis is provided for intelligent control of the harvester.

title: Monitoring device for preventing agricultural diseases and pests and preventing method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring device for preventing agricultural diseases and pests and a preventing method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural equipment. The monitoringdevice for preventing the agricultural diseases and pests comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a monitoring system and a spraying system; the unmanned aerial vehicle main body comprises avehicle body, rotor wings, brackets and a storage battery; the monitoring system comprises a camera and a controller, and the controller comprises an image processing module, a storage module and a main control module; and the spraying system comprises spraying mechanisms, and each spraying mechanism comprises a pesticide box, a nozzle, a pesticide guide pipe and an electromagnetic valve. Comparedwith the prior art, the monitoring device for preventing the agricultural diseases and pests can timely monitor and thoroughly prevent the agricultural diseases and pests, spreading of the diseases and pests is avoided, meanwhile, the diseases and pests can be subjected to targeted preventing, and the problem of pesticide wasting caused by large-area pesticide spraying is solved.

title: Crop cultivation and farming support system using agricultural robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a crop cultivation and farming support system using an agricultural robot and, more specifically, to a crop cultivation and farming support system using an agricultural robot, which automates cultivation of crops through the agricultural robot and provides various agricultural information to facilitate the cultivation of crops. According to the present invention, the crop cultivation and farming support system using an agricultural robot systematically provides professional farming information to farmers, especially those who lack professional farming knowledge or information, thereby providing an advantage of lowering the barriers to enter farming. In addition, the system provides advantages of automating cultivation of crops through an agricultural robot to facilitate the cultivation of crops, providing agricultural information such as sowing or cultivation method and the like of crops selected by farmers by season or solar term, enabling the farmers to simply and easily make a farming diary including work history in real-time, and growing the crops systematically. The system comprises an agricultural robot, an environment controller, a user terminal, a distributed robot server, a cultivation technology standardization server, and a central robot server.

title: Cutter cutting frequency self-adaptation control device and method and harvester
abstract: The invention discloses a cutter cutting frequency self-adaptation control device and method and a harvester. The control device comprises a control module and a cutting effect monitoring module, an executing module, a signal collecting and conditioning module, a manual/automatic mode automatic switching module and a man-machine interaction module which are in signal connection with the control module. The control method is mainly a compound control strategy of swing ring mechanism spindle rotation speed compensation and fuzzy control, the machine vision technology is used to monitor the cutting effect in real time, and a swing ring mechanism spindle rotation speed compensator is designed; in order to reduce system overshoot and guarantee system rapidity, a fuzzy control algorithm is usedto control swing ring mechanism spindle rotation speed, and finally cutter cutting frequency control is achieved. The cutter cutting frequency self-adaptation control device and method has the advantages that cutting frequency self-adaptation adjusting can be achieved, machine energy consumption and vibration and grain harvesting loss can be reduced favorably, operator workload can be reduced, andthe intelligent development of a combined harvester is benefited.

title: AUTONOMOUSLY TRAVELING WORK VEHICLE
abstract: The present invention relates to a traveling device in which front wheels and rear wheels are configured to be driven. According to the present invention, the traveling device comprises: a deck disposed between the front wheel and the rear wheel and configured to have a blade for mowing the lower lawn; a deck position adjustment unit for adjusting lifting and lowering of the deck; a camera for photographing front or the rear of the traveling device; a vehicle control unit which determines the inclination of the work area from an image photographed by the camera and controls operation of the traveling device according to a result of the determination; and a sensor unit including a gyro sensor and a position sensor for measuring the tilt or position of the traveling device.

title: Crop Dusting Drones Capable of Lateral Spraying
abstract: A crop dusting drone capable of lateral spraying is disclosed. The crop dusting drone capable of lateral spraying comprises: a main body extending from side to side in a predetermined length from one side to the other side; a plurality of rotor units provided in a predetermined distance in an upper portion of the main body to enable the main body to make a flight; a medicine storage unit provided in a lower portion of the main body, and storing a medicine; and a medicine spray unit provided in a predetermined distance in the lower portion of the main body, and having at least one lateral spraying unit supplied with the medicine from the medicine storage unit to spray the medicine in a lateral direction.

title: Intelligent unmanned seeding and fertilizing device and method based on machine vision
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent unmanned seeding and fertilizing device based on machine vision in the technical field of machine vision, which comprises a tractor, a feeding device is mounted in a hopper of the tractor, and the feeding device comprises a connecting pipe communicated with the hopper; the first material pipe is rotatably mounted at the top end of the connecting pipe and is communicated with the connecting pipe; the first power part is used for driving the first material pipe to rotate; the front end of the second material pipe is mounted at the top end of the first material pipe and is communicated with the first connecting rod; the third material pipe is mounted at the tail end of the second material pipe and is communicated with the second material pipe; the fourth material pipe is rotatably mounted at the bottom end of the third material pipe and is communicated with the third material pipe; the second power part is used for driving the fourth material pipe to rotate; the camera is installed on the fourth material pipe and used for shooting an image of the feeding position below the fourth material pipe, the camera is used for obtaining image information, the feeding port is efficiently and accurately positioned through the computer vision technology, intelligent seed adding and fertilizer adding are achieved, and the production efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Intelligent robot for harvesting garlic sprouts and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent robot for harvesting garlic sprouts and a working method thereof, and belongs to the field of agricultural intelligent equipment. The robot comprises one or more harvesting devices, a moving platform, a control system and a power system; the harvesting devices are located at the front end of the moving platform, and each harvesting device comprises a three-dimensional sliding table, a clamping and tying assembly, an identifying and positioning assembly, a feeding assembly and a garlic sprout container; the three-dimensional sliding table, the clamping and tying assembly, the identifying and positioning assembly, the feeding assembly, the moving platform and the power system are all connected with the control system. The intelligent robot for harvesting the garlic sprouts has the advantages that artificial intelligence and mechanical design are combined skillfully, the operation process of manual garlic sprout harvesting is simulated, and the high-speed identification and positioning of garlic plants and accurate and fast harvesting of garlic sprouts are achieved through plant identifying, plant clamping, plant smoothing, garlic sprout tying,garlic sprout lifting, garlic sprout feeding, walking and other steps; the robot is adopted for harvesting the garlic sprouts, the harvesting amount is quantifiable, the harvesting progress is predictable, and the harvesting quality can be ensured.

title: REMOTE CONTROL APPARATUS
abstract: A remote control apparatus 112 capable of communicating with a control apparatus 30 of an autonomously running work vehicle 1 via a communication apparatus 110, the remote control apparatus 112 comprising a communication apparatus 111, a control apparatus 119, a display apparatus 113, and cameras 42F, 42R for obtaining images of the front and rear, wherein the display apparatus 113 is provided with at least a remote control region 113A for controlling the autonomously running work vehicle 1, a peripheral image region 113B for displaying images captured by the cameras 42F, 42R, and a work status display region 113C, wherein the peripheral image region 113B is provided with a frontal view and a rear view.

title: Seed valve and planting method for multiple seed types
abstract: Various planting machines and planting methods are described. A planting method may include filling a seed pool with first-type seed, metering the first-type seed from the seed pool with a metering member, and then evacuating the first-type seed from the seed pool. The method may further include filling the seed pool with second-type seed, metering the second-type seed with the metering member, evacuating the second-type seed from the seed pool, and then refilling the seed pool with the first-type seed. First-type and second-type seed may be evacuated to separate temporary storage chambers, and the seed pool may be filled from the temporary storage chambers, as well as from bulk storage containers. A seed valve of a planting machine may include temporary seed storage chambers for different seed types. The seed valve may fill and evacuate a seed pool through rotation of various valve members and selective application of a vacuum.

title: Autonomous agricultural robot (agbot) for decision making and courses of action considering real-time conditions
abstract: An autonomous agricultural system receives weather information and determines preferred courses of action based on the information received.

title: Method And System For Facilitating Management Of Seed Production
abstract: Disclosed herein is a system of facilitating management of a seed production process, the system comprising: a facility for storage and processing of the seed product; transportation means for transporting the product or seed product between the field and the facility; and the system further comprising a data storage medium, a processor which is configured to communicate over a network to send, receive and store information relating to the seed product or seed production process to and from the at least one data storage medium and between users to facilitate assessment and monitoring of the seed production process. Also disclosed is a method of facilitating management of a seed production process. wo 118 112' 110 11 - 108 Figure 2

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR APPLYING AN AGRICULTURAL PRACTICE TO A TARGET AGRICULTURAL FIELD
abstract: There is provided a method comprising: computing state parameter(s) indicative of a state of a target crop at the target field based on output of crop physiological sensor(s), and classifying by a classifier(s), the state parameter(s) and the agricultural practice(s) into instructions for administration of the agricultural practice(s) to the target field, wherein yield and/or quality of the target crop at a future target event is predicted to be increased when the instructions are implemented relative to the yield and/or quality of the target crop that is predicted at the future target event when an alternative administration of the agricultural practice(s) is implemented, wherein the classifier(s) computes the instructions based on previously obtained instructions associated with respective reference fields associated with respective state parameter(s), and yield and/or quality of respective reference crops at respective reference fields at historical reference events corresponding to the future target event.

title: Agricultural seeding device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-based agricultural seeding device, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a screening cavity and a feeding cavity, the screening cavity communicates with a storage box through a guide groove, a feeding column is fixedly installed in the feeding cavity, and a spiralfeeding plate is arranged around the periphery of the feeding column; the width of the material guiding groove is the same as the diameter of seeds, a plurality of through holes are formed in the connecting position of the feeding column and the spiral feeding plate, the seeds sequentially enter the spiral feeding plate and pass through the through holes one by one, intermittent sowing of the seeds is achieved, and the problem that seed development is affected due to excessive one-time sowing is avoided. Seeds fall into a field to be sown after entering the material distributing pipe in turn,the sliding telescopic pipe can increase the length of the material distributing pipe and increase the sowing area, wizened seeds enter the collecting box through the sieving holes to be collected, sieving of the seeds is achieved, wizened bad seeds are effectively removed, and the sowing efficiency is improved.

title: Method and system for augmenting a guidance system with a path sensor
abstract: In an automatic vehicle position control system, such as a satellite-based agricultural implement steering system, the satellite-based steering information is adjusted with information obtained from one or more path sensors to facilitate the automatic nudging of the vehicle to take account of inaccurate tracking of the agricultural implement relative to its tractor, terrain variations, and inaccuracies in the satellite-based steering system.

title: ADMINISTRATION SYSTEM
abstract: To administrate per work, setting information of a work vehicle set in a field work.SOLUTION: An administration system S comprises a work vehicle 1 and a server 50. The work vehicle 1 comprises; a work device 2; a vehicle body 3 capable of traveling by manual steering or automatic steering based on a reference line; a position detection device 43 which detects the position of the vehicle body 3; a first storage device 41 which when the vehicle body 3 is automatically steered, stores relation information in which setting information of the work vehicle 1 is made to correspond to the position information of the vehicle body 3; and a first communication device 42 which transmits the relation information stored by the first storage device 41 to the server 50. The server 50 comprises: a second communication device 52 which receives the relation information transmitted from the first communication device 42; and a second storage device 53 which stores the relation information received by the second communication device 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING AN ORIENTATION OF AN AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENT DURING AN AGRICULTURAL OPERATION
abstract: In one aspect, a system for monitoring an orientation of an agricultural implement during an agricultural operation is disclosed. The system may include a work vehicle and an agricultural implement coupled to the work vehicle and configured to be towed by the work vehicle. The system may include a vision-based sensor coupled to the work vehicle and a controller communicatively coupled to the vision-based sensor. The controller may include a processor and associated memory. The memory may store instructions that, when executed by the processor, configure the controller to receive image data from the vision-based sensor; determine an orientation parameter based on the received image data; and initiate a corrective action based on the orientation parameter of the agricultural implement while the agricultural implement is being towed by the work vehicle. The orientation parameter may describe an orientation of the agricultural implement relative to the work vehicle.

title: Harvester, has local discrete detection of crop yield by electronic evaluation and/or memory unit detecting drive torque and drive power of belt conveyor moving cut material
abstract: The harvester has a mower with local discrete detection of the yield of the crop. A belt conveyor for the cut material is placed adjoining the mower and an electronic evaluation and/or memory unit is provided for locally detecting the drive torque detected by the sensor elements and/or the drive power for the belt conveyor. The drive torque and power can be determined by means of at least one pressure sensor in a hydraulic line of the drive for the belt conveyor. An independent claim is included for a method for detecting yield where cut material is passed on a conveyor, with the drive torque and power of the latter being determined and with these position coordinates through an electronic evaluation and/or memory unit the relative yield being determined in relation to location.

title: ADJUSTABLE CLOSING SYSTEM
abstract: An agricultural implement system that includes a row unit coupled to a tool bar of an agricultural implement. An opener system coupled to the row unit that engages soil to form a trench. A soil condition sensor. A closing system that closes the trench created by the opener system. The closing system includes a first disk that engages the soil and closes the trench. A second disk that engages the soil and closes the trench. A controller that couples to the soil condition sensor and controls a position or orientation of the first disk or the second disk in response to feedback from the soil condition sensor.

title: Transforming Agriculture Through MOR.
abstract: Our Invention Transforming Agriculture Through MOR is a Smart agriculture using MOR which mainly consists of a virtual assistant and the monitoring center. It comprises of a well-designed data driven map that enables the farmers to know the type of crops grown and their diseases in their area. It also enables them to know the potential Agri-markets along with prevailing prices in their location. In case of virtual assistant, it acts like a multitasker, which can do major tasks like plant disease detection, irrigation status, soil nutrient status, weather forecast prediction along with their work history. It can also automatically inform the nearest KVK's (Krishi Vigyan Kendra) about the major problems that the farmer (user) is facing. The invention is also looking the farmers is that the selection of correct yield for farming and Several factors influence the yield of crops like rain, C-Deg temperature, soil, Crop prediction helps Indian farmers in choosing the right and real-time crop for plantation to maximize their earning. title: AGRICULTURAL SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING THE PERFORMANCE OF AN AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENT
abstract: An agricultural system for monitoring the performance of an agricultural implement includes an agricultural implement having at least one ground engaging tool, and one or more Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) sensors having a field of view directed toward a portion of the field worked by the agricultural implement during the agricultural operation. The sensor(s) generates first light at a first output frequency and second light at a second output frequency, with the first output frequency being different than the second output frequency, and generates first data indicative of reflection of the first light off the portion of the field and second data indicative of reflection of the second light off the portion of the field. Additionally, the system includes a computing system that determines a surface feature parameter of the portion of the field based at least in part on the first data and the second data.

title: Autonomous land maintenance equipement
abstract: An automated land maintenance vehicle includes means for performing a maintenance operation, receiving means for waste material, guidance means, obstacle detecting means and an emptying means to deposit the waste material. The maintenance operation means may be a lawn mower, the guidance means may include a laser scanner 7 or a global positioning system and the obstacle detecting means may be tactile sensing bumpers 1,6 or an energy wave emitting and detecting device (29 figure 6). The emptying means may include a supporting arm 8,9 which is operated by a lift actuator 15 to raise a grass catcher 12 to an emptying position. The grass catcher 12 may then be opened by an actuator 23 to deposit collected grass cuttings beyond the range of the obstacle detection means 1,6. An alternative method of depositing the waste material is shown in figure 7 where a grass catcher 30a, 30b is rotated about a pivot 32 when in an emptying position.

title: CROP YIELD AND OBSTRUCTION DETECTION SYSTEM FOR A HARVESTING HEADER
abstract: A system including sensors to sense predefined measurable elements associated with a portion or portions of a utilized width currently engaged in harvesting on and relative to a harvesting mechanism while a harvester traverses a crop field and to output a signal or to adjust an operational characteristic of the harvester or the harvesting mechanism. The system may be configured to sense predefined measurable elements relative to a single crop row or single crop plant of utilized width. The system can be configured to sense predefined measurable elements at a distance between about five feet behind and ten feet in front of the harvesting mechanism. The system may implement a method generally comprising the steps of sensing the predefined measurable element, storing a crop-related data value, and associating the crop-related data value with a time-related data value to adjust the operational characteristics of the harvesting mechanism.

title: Determining image feature height disparity
abstract: A device to determine a height disparity between features of an image includes a memory including instructions and processing circuitry. The processing circuitry is configured by the instructions to obtain an image including a first repetitive feature and a second repetitive feature. The processing circuitry is further configured by the instructions to determine a distribution of pixels in a first area of the image, where the first area includes an occurrence of the repetitive features, and to determine a distribution of pixels in a second area of the image, where the second area includes another occurrence of the repetitive features. The processing circuitry is further configured by the instructions to evaluate the distribution of pixels in the first area and the distribution of pixels in the second area to determine a height difference between the first repetitive feature and the second repetitive feature.

title: Agricultural prime mover
abstract: An agricultural prime mover, such as a tractor, may be used to execute an agricultural work process. The agricultural prime mover includes work assemblies that can be adjusted with machine parameters, and can be coupled to an attachment for processing a field. The agricultural prime mover includes a control and regulation module that optimizes the work assemblies by ascertaining machine parameters for the work assemblies using optimization data with respect to at least one objective. The control and regulation module executes a multi-step optimization strategy, including a first step “at the farm” directed to optimizing a basic configuration of the agricultural prime mover, a second step “at the field” directed to optimizing an attachment-specific configuration of the agricultural prime mover, and a third step “in the field” directed to optimizing the adaptation of the basic configuration and the attachment-specific configuration while processing the field.

title: TRANSPORTING FOLDED WING AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENTS
abstract: A method of transporting an implement with folded wings in a full transport position where the height of the implement is greater than a clearance height of utility comprising marking the overhead line locations on a digital guidance map with a monitor configured to activate an alarm when the implement approaches a line location. When the alarm activates and prior to arriving at the approaching line location the implement is moved from the full transport position to a partial transport position where the height of the implement is less than the clearance height. The implement is then driven under the utility line and the implement is moved from the partial transport position to the full transport position and driving along the road continues until arrival at the desired field or another line location. A wing transport system can move the wings in a coordinated manner.

title: Intelligent pesticide spraying robot self-adaptive to terrain of mountain land
abstract: An intelligent pesticide spraying robot self-adaptive to terrain of mountain land is provided. Walking mechanisms are respectively connected to both side ends of a chassis. A pesticide spraying mechanism includes rotary drive mechanisms respectively connected to both sides of the rear end of the chassis, telescopic spray boom mechanisms correspondingly connected to the rotary drive mechanisms, rotary nozzle mechanisms correspondingly connected to the telescopic spray boom mechanisms, a liquid pesticide storage box fixed to the top of the chassis, a first water pump fixed in the liquid pesticide storage box, and first water pipes in communication with the first water pump and the rotary nozzle mechanisms. A control chip of a control identification mechanism is communicatively connected to the walking mechanisms, the rotary drive mechanisms, the telescopic spray boom mechanisms, the rotary nozzle mechanisms, the first water pump, a front-end camera, side-end cameras and ultrasonic sensors respectively.

title: Non-destructive stalk and root contact sensor with variable rate tensioner
abstract: An apparatus and methods for non-destructively analyzing the strength of plant roots and stalks, and uses of this information in plant breeding, crop production, and detection of plant pathology. The apparatus and methods involve the use of a variable rate tensioner that may be automatically or remotely adjusted based on crop conditions.

title: Method and control unit for adjusting the operating width of a plough
abstract: Verfahren (100) zur Einstellung einer Arbeitsbreite (A) eines Pflugs (1), wobei die Pflugposition (P) auf einem Feld (3) mit einem Ortungssystem erfasst wird, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass das Feld (3) in wenigstens einen Abschnitt (4) mit zwei geraden Abschnittsgrenzen (41, 43) unterteilt wird, dass ein Zentralpunkt (Z) als Schnittpunkt der Abschnittsgrenzen (41, 43) oder deren gedachten Verlängerungen ermittelt wird, dass eine Distanz (D) zwischen der Pflugposition (P) und einer der Abschnittsgrenzen (41) entlang eines Kreisbogens (B) um den Zentralpunkt (Z) berechnet wird, und mittels der Distanz (D) die Arbeitsbreite (A) des Pflugs (1) bestimmt und/oder eingestellt wird.

title: Method for cultivating new variety of drought-tolerant wheat
abstract: The invention discloses a method for cultivating a new variety of drought-tolerant wheat. The method includes the steps that first, after dormancy breaking and germination acceleration are performed on wheat, the wheat is forcibly vernalized to be 3 cm tall; second, when leaves of edible cactuses grow to be 80 mm to 100 mm long, the leaves are cut off on the leaf roots; third, the wheat is cut off on the tillering nodes, and the parts above the tillering nodes of the wheat serve as scions; fourth, grafting holes are drilled in the positions 20 mm to 30 mm away on the leaves of the edible cactuses; fifth, the scions are inserted in the grafting holes; sixth, the grafted scions are moved into a nutrition cultivation box to be cultivated for 30 to 35 days, water is sprayed, and foliage dressing is performed; seventh, the grafted scions are moved into an artificial intelligent climatic chamber, and wheat seeds are harvested after three months; eighth, 50% of the wheat seeds are grafted to the leaves of the edible cactuses for backcross, and second filial generation seeds are obtained; ninth, 50% of the second filial generation seeds are grafted to the leaves of the edible cactuses for backcross for the third time, and third filial generation seeds are obtained. According to the method, through root-cutting regeneration of allopolyploid wheat, the new variety of drought-tolerant wheat is cultivated, and the new variety of drought-tolerant wheat has good drought tolerance so that the yield of the wheat can be expected to increase.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a work vehicle capable of detecting a boundary line of a trace before and after performing work with a simple structure, and capable of autonomously traveling along the boundary line.SOLUTION: A mowing vehicle 1 comprises a travel machine body 10 and a mowing device 20. The mowing vehicle further comprises: a first imaging device 30; and a control part C for controlling the travel machine body 10 to autonomously travel, along a boundary line before and after mowing grasses which is formed by a mowing device 20. The control part C comprises: a boundary line detection part C2 for detecting the boundary line; and a travel control part C3 for controlling a travel direction of the travel machine body 10. The boundary line detection part C2 creates intensity distribution information related to texture information in a predetermined direction, by performing filtering processing using a Gabor filter based on the imaged image, then, performing statistic processing to the intensity distribution information, for every inspection area of plural areas being divided in a vertical direction for detecting the boundary point, then, detects the boundary line based on the boundary point of each inspection area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: AGRICULTURAL DEVICE FOR WORKING A FIELD
abstract: The present invention relates to an agricultural device for working a field, receiving system configured to receive data from an agricultural device, system for collecting and storing 5 agricultural data, and a method for aggregating data from an agricultural device. The agricultural device comprising: - tool for working the field; - a data aggregation system configured to collect a plurality of measurements at a time (T); 10 - a data processing unit, operatively connected to the data aggregation system; - a memory, operatively connected to the data processing unit; - a communication module operatively connected to the data processing unit; Wherein the data processing unit is configured to process each measurement from the plurality of measurements from the data aggregation system.

title: Crop moisture sensor for controlling harvesting speed
abstract: An agricultural combine having a supporting structure that is driven by ground engaging wheels at a harvesting speed by a propulsion assembly. The combine is also provided with a threshing assembly that is supplied harvested crop material by a feederhouse. The feederhouse is provided with a moisture sensor for sensing the moisture of harvested crop material as it passes through the feederhouse. The moisture sensor produces a moisture signal that is directed to an electronic combine controller. The electronic combine controller regulates the harvesting speed of the combine in response to the moisture signal.

title: A METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CHARACTERISING THE SOIL MOISTURE CHARACTERISTICS OF MANAGEMENT ZONES IN BOTH TIME AND SPACE, SPECIFIC TO ZONE-BASED MANAGEMENT FOR VARIABLE RATE CROP INPUTS
abstract: A method and system for a hydrological process that describes and characterises either statically or temporally, soil moisture variability within agricultural fields, specific to zone-based field recommendations. Surface and subsurface hydrological processes are combined with soil physical properties, electrical conductivity (EC), topography, soil moisture sensors and climate parameters from weather stations, to produce a zone-based soil moisture balance. This process facilitates in-season optimization of crop inputs such as water from irrigation, seed, nutrients, herbicides, or pesticides based on the soil moisture conditions throughout a field.

title: MACHINE-LEARNED TILLAGE MALFUNCTION DETECTION IN AN AUTONOMOUS FARMING VEHICLE
abstract: A detection system (210) detects malfunctions in an autonomous farming vehicle during an autonomous routine using one or more models and data from sensors (220) coupled to the autonomous farming vehicle. The models may include machine-learned models (310) trained on the sensor data and configured to identify objects indicative of an operational or malfunctioning component within a tilling assembly such as a tilling shank (350) or sweep (360). Additionally, a machine-learned model may be trained on sensor data to detect whether debris has plugged the tilling assembly of the autonomous farming vehicle (370). In response to detecting a malfunction or a plug, the detection system may modify the autonomous routine (e.g., pausing operation) or provide information for the malfunction to be addressed (e.g., the likely location of a malfunctioning sweep that has detached from the tilling assembly).

title: Process of command of an action or a sequence of actions
abstract: The method involves automatically triggering an action or a sequence of actions to be carried out in an agricultural machine (1) via a control of a controller (10) of the machine by detecting a state change of one of control units (5) of a tractor (2) using a monitoring system (11) that provides information to the controller. The control units are chosen from actuators such as hitch or power take-off shaft, and power distributors such as hydraulic distributor or electrical power distributor.

title: SOIL CHARACTERISTICS SURVEY DEVICE AND SOIL CHARACTERISTICS SURVEY METHOD
abstract: PURPOSE: Provided is an observation apparatus for soil characteristics which is capable of efficiently obtaining data of high accuracy related to the distribution of soil characteristics in a field to collectively control the same. CONSTITUTION: An observation apparatus for soil characteristics is equipped with a pedestal connected to the rear part of a tractor, a control part (computer) placed on the pedestal and a soil cutting part attached to the lower part of the rear end of the pedestal and drawn by a vehicle such as the tractor or the like to observe the distribution of soil characteristics in the field in a real time. A GPS antenna is attached to the head of the control part. A soil cutting part is equipped with a shank supported on and connected to the lower part of the pedestal and a sensing part fixed to the lower part of the shank and almost advancing through soil at a predetermined depth. The control part forms a group of data corresponding to the same soil sample with respect to the soil characteristics to be detected or the detection signals of various sensors or the like different in arrangement.

title: Farming Machine Control and Generation of Operational Settings Based on Geographically-Linked Farming Images
abstract: Described herein are technologies for controlling farming machines and generating enhanced operational settings for farming machines based on geographically-linked farming images or advance geographically-linked farming images. In some embodiments, a computing system includes instructions executable by a processor to receive geographically-linked farming images captured by a camera of a farming machine as well as geographic position information of the farming machine linked to the images. Also, the computing system includes instructions executable by a processor to determine enhanced operational settings based on the geographically-linked farming images and the geographic position information. In some examples, the determination of the enhanced operational settings is further based on received additional farming information linked to the geographically-linked farming images.

title: Machine control using a predictive map
abstract: One or more information maps are obtained by an agricultural work machine. The one or more information maps map one or more agricultural characteristic values at different geographic locations of a field. An in-situ sensor on the agricultural work machine senses an agricultural characteristic as the agricultural work machine moves through the field. A predictive map generator generates a predictive map that predicts a predictive agricultural characteristic at different locations in the field based on a relationship between the values in the one or more information maps and the agricultural characteristic sensed by the in-situ sensor. The predictive map can be output and used in automated machine control.

title: CROP-EXTRACTION SYSTEM HAVING AN UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE, AND RELATED METHODS
abstract: A crop-extraction system includes a crop-conveying medium, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles tethered together and configured to suspend the crop-conveying medium in air, and at least one crop-extraction device configured to extract crop and transfer the crop to the crop-conveying medium. Other crop-extraction systems include a ground vehicle carrying a storage bin, a crop-conveying medium coupled to the ground vehicle, and an unmanned aerial vehicle coupled to the crop-conveying medium and configured to extract crop and transfer the crop to the crop-conveying medium for deposit into the storage bin. Related methods are also disclosed.

title: AGRICULTURAL SYSTEM
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein landwirtschaftliches Arbeitssystem mit einer landwirtschaftlichen Arbeitsmaschine (2), insbesondere einer Erntemaschine, zur Bewirtschaftung einer landwirtschaftlichen Fläche (3) und mit einer Drohne (4) zur Unterstützung der Bewirtschaftung, wobei die Drohne (4) eine aufladbare Batterie (6) aufweist und wobei die landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine (2) eine Ladestation (7) zum Laden der Batterie (6) aufweist. Es wird vorgeschlagen, dass die Ladestation (7) einen Laser-Emitter (8), der Energie über einen Laser-Strahl (9) in einen Wirkbereich (10) abgeben kann, aufweist, dass die Drohne (4) einen mit der Batterie (6) elektrisch gekoppelten Laser-Receiver (11), der Energie von dem Laser-Strahl (9) aufnehmen und in die Batterie (6) einspeisen kann, aufweist und dass die Drohne (4) im Flug im Wirkbereich (10) über den Laser-Strahl (9) von der Ladestation (7) mit Energie zum Laden der Batterie (6) versorgt werden kann.

title: GRAPHICAL YIELD MONITOR REAL-TIME DATA DISPLAY
abstract: A yield monitoring system for an agricultural harvester has an in-cab display. The in-cab display has at least one configurable user defined window operable to view at least two parameters simultaneously and comparatively in graphical format and in real time. The at least two parameters include data from at least one yield monitoring sensor or vehicle sensor. The in-cab display may have a menu allowing the choice of paired data sources to be viewed simultaneously and comparatively. Data sources may include quantity of crop yielded, moisture content of crop yielded, rate of flow of crop through the agricultural harvester, protein content of crop yielded, ground speed, speed of operation of the grain elevator, and height of the header above the ground.

title: Combine harvester control interface for operator and/or remote user
abstract: A user device, that is remote from a combine harvester, communicates with a remote system to receive performance metrics corresponding to sensed operation of a plurality of different combine harvesters. A performance display element, for each machine, and for each of a plurality of different performance criteria, is generated. Display control logic controls a display device so the performance display elements are displayed with display elements corresponding to a same performance criteria, but for different combine harvesters, being displayed adjacent one another, on the display device. The display control logic also controls the display device so the performance machine display elements for the plurality of different combine harvesters are also displayed along with a performance distribution display element that represents a performance distribution of a plurality of different machines.

title: Deep learning system and method for predicting crop characteristics
abstract: A deep learning system is used to predict crop characteristics from inputs that include crop variety features, environmental features, and field management features. The deep learning system includes domain-specific modules for each category of features. Some of the domain-specific modules are implemented as convolutional neural networks (CNN) while others are implemented as fully-connected neural networks. Interactions between different domains are captured with cross attention between respective embeddings. Embeddings from the multiple domain-specific modules are concatenated to create a deep neural network (DNN). The prediction generated by the DNN is a characteristic of the crop such as yield, height, or disease resistance. The DNN can be used to select a crop variety for planting in a field. For a crop that is planted, the DNN may be used to select a field management technique.

title: USING OPTICAL SENSORS TO RESOLVE VEHICLE HEADING ISSUES
abstract: A control system (100) fuses different sensor data together to determine an orientation of a vehicle (50). The control system (100) receives visual heading data for the vehicle (50) from a camera system (102), global navigation satellite system (GNSS) heading data from a GNSS system (108), and inertial measurement unit (IMU) heading data from an IMU (110). The control system (100) may assign weights to the visual, GNSS, and IMU heading data based on operating conditions of the vehicle (50) that can vary accuracy associated with the different visual, GNSS, and IMU data. The control system (100) then uses the weighted visual, GNSS, and IMU data to determine a more accurate vehicle heading.

title: CONTROL METHOD AND EQUIPMENT FOR AUTOMATICALLY PERFORMING AGRICULTURAL WORKS BY MOBILE AGRICULTURAL AGGREGATES
abstract: The invention relates to a control method and a control equipment for automatically performing, without the human factor participation, the agricultural works, by mobile aggregates, tractor-agricultural machine or power-propelled agricultural machine. According to the invention, the equipment uses a (portable or stationary) digital computer (1), of the IMB-PC type, an interface (2) between the computer (1) and the GPS global positioning system, a radio remote control equipment working in PCM (pulse code modulation). There was used the radio remote control equipment, which works in PCM, because it is practically impossible to be jammed. According to the invention, the method uses the congruence between the aggregate trajectory, indicated by the GPS system and that prescribed in the digital computer memory, which is performed due to an original computer programme, conceived and performed by the author of the invention.

title: WORK VEHICLE AND WORK PATH GENERATION DEVICE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To properly set a travel finish position of a work vehicle which autonomously travels, for improving a work efficiency of an adjoint work vehicle.SOLUTION: An autonomous travel work vehicle 1 comprises: a vehicle body part 2; a work machine 24; a movement GPS antenna 34; a memory 309; a control part 30; and a remote control device 112. By the control part 30, while detecting a current position N of the vehicle body part 2 by a movement GPS antenna 35 in a farm field H stored in a storage part 309, the travel work vehicle can autonomously travel along a path R, in which the farm field H contains a work area HA containing a work path Ra, and a headland HB not containing the work path Ra. The control part 30 can make the vehicle body part 2 travel from a work finish position Gw of the work path Ra to a travel finish position Gr set in the headland HB after finish of work by the work machine 24 on the work path Ra.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: AGRICULTURAL ROBOT
abstract: It is possible to easily estimate a crop (2) from sensor data (H11).An agricultural robot (1) includes a traveling body (3), a working unit (4) to do work relating to a crop (2), the working unit (4) being provided on the traveling body (3), an optical sensor (5A, 5B) provided on the traveling body (3), and a crop estimator (411) to perform estimation of the crop (2) based on sensor data (H11) obtained by the optical sensor (5A, 5B), wherein the crop estimator (41I) includes a data extractor (85) to designate the crop (2) to be subjected to the estimation based on the sensor data (H11) and extract, as partial data (H13), a part of the sensor data (H11) that corresponds to the designated crop (2), and an estimator (86) to perform the estimation of the crop (2) based on a surface condition of the crop (2) obtained from the partial data (H13) extracted by the data extractor (85).

title: System and method for calculating instantaneous placement corrections to achieve towed implement placement on curved paths
abstract: A global positioning system (GPS) based navigation and steering control system for ground vehicles, in particular, agricultural ground vehicles such as tractors, combines, sprayers, seeders, or the like, calculates instantaneous placement corrections to achieve desired towed implement placement on curved paths, and a method for same.

title: Intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle for agricultural plant protection
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural plant protection intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle which structurally comprises a monitoring device, a processing device, supporting legs, a supporting rod, a vehicle body, a data collector, wings and propellers. When the agricultural plant protection intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle is used, a main body is mounted at the lower end of the vehicle body through a mounting frame, seeds needing to be sown are guided into a seed storage box, and needed pesticide is injected into a pesticide storage assembly; when the machine body flies for seeding, seeds are uniformly distributed in a farmland through the seeding assembly, and after seeding is completed, pesticide is sprayed to the farmland through the spraying piece at the lower end of the pesticide storage assembly for fertilization treatment, so that the growth rate of crops is increased.

title: Agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle pesticide spraying machine
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle pesticide applying machine, which structurally comprises a machine body, a resonator, a damping layer and a liquid level sensor, the two sides of the machine body are fixedly connected with side wings, the tops of the side wings are fixedly connected with the bottom of an electronic speed controller, the top of the electronic speed controller is electrically connected with a motor, the motor is connected with a propeller bearing, the top of the machine body is in screw connection with a pesticide box, the top of the pesticide box is provided with a water pump, the water pump is in threaded connection with one end of a water outlet pipe, the other end of the water outlet pipe is in threaded connection with a spray pipe, the spray pipe is provided with a spray head, the machine body is internally provided with a power supply, the left side of the power supply is electrically connected to a communication module, the left side of the communication module is provided with a resonator, the outer side of the pesticide box is bonded with the damping layer, and a liquid level sensor is arranged in the pesticide box. According to the agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle pesticide spraying machine, the resonator improves the frequency precision and enhances the anti-interference capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the damping layer reduces the vibration frequency of the unmanned aerial vehicle and improves the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the liquid level sensor feeds back the liquid level information of the pesticide box.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle farmland control irrigation system and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle farmland control irrigation system and a working method. The system and the method can be used for unattended irrigation of crops needing water. Theunmanned aerial vehicle farmland control irrigation system comprises a core processor, a crop growth vigor module, a flight power module, a positioning module, a pesticide spraying module, a soil cracking module, a wireless transceiving module, a farmland spray irrigation control module, a water level detection module and a computer. According to the method, farmland cracks are shot by an unmannedaerial vehicle, and the shot images are processed through the computer, so that the cracking degree of the cracks is determined; the growth vigor of the crops is determined through the crop growth vigor identification module. According to the initial stage, middle stage and later stage of the crops and the corresponding small, intermediate and large cracking degrees, the soil is irrigated with acertain amount of water to cover the soil.

title: Pesticide spraying structure special for unmanned aerial vehicle and using method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a special pesticide spraying structure for an unmanned aerial vehicle. The structure comprises anunmanned aerial vehicle body, a water tank part and a pesticide dispensing part, wherein the water tank part is connected with the upper end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the pesticide dispensing part is arranged at the upper end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and is connected with the upper portion of the water tank part, the two sides of the water tank part are provided with a waterinlet and a liquid outlet correspondingly, and the liquid outlet communicates with a nozzle through a pipe. According to the structure, the problems that an existing unmanned aerial vehicle needs to return to the starting point to conduct quantitative proportioning on pesticide again, the efficiency is low when crops in different growth periods or growth states are sprayed, and continuous sprayingcannot be carried out are solved.

title: System and method for cutting table length adaptation
abstract: An agricultural harvester is disclosed. The agricultural harvester includes a cutting unit that has a cutting table adjustable in its cutting table length, a reel adjustable to a reel vertical position and reel longitudinal position, an inclined conveyor downstream from the cutting unit, and a driver assistance system. The driver assistance system autonomously determines, using at least one input variable, at least one machine parameter and specifies the machine parameter to the cutting unit. The machine parameter can include one or more of the cutting table length, the reel vertical position, or the reel longitudinal position. In particular, the driver assistance system may determine a harvested material throughput and a vibration coefficient describing the fluctuation in the harvested material throughput in a region lying in front of the threshing system and adapt or modify the cutting table length based on the determined vibration coefficient.

title: Fine agriculture water-saving irrigation method
abstract: The invention discloses a water-saving irrigation method for precision agriculture, which comprises the steps of channel water delivery, pipeline water delivery, spray irrigation, micro-spray, drip irrigation, film covering irrigation and mark irrigation, and the channel water delivery adopts concrete surface protection seepage prevention, stone laying seepage prevention, concrete seepage prevention or plastic film seepage prevention; the pipeline water delivery comprises a water delivery pipeline, the water delivery pipeline is a concrete pipe, a plastic hard pipe, a plastic hose or a metal pipe, and the pipeline water delivery enables the utilization coefficient of water to reach 0.90-1; the spray irrigation comprises a spray irrigation pipe, and the spray irrigation pipe disperses water into water drops by utilizing the inner wall pressure and uniformly sprays the water drops to the field; the micro-spraying utilizes a plastic pipeline to convey water, and the micro-spraying head sprays water to carry out local irrigation; drip irrigation comprises a drip tank pipe, a through hole is formed in the drip tank pipe, and water is conveyed to roots of crops through the through hole for local irrigation; water can be saved by at least more than 30%, and for a water lifting irrigation area and a well irrigation area, water saving means that the water lifting cost is reduced, so that the purpose of efficiently utilizing water resources is achieved.

title: AGRICULTURAL DRONE HAVING IMPROVED SAFETY
abstract: [Problem] To provide an agrochemical spraying drone that is highly safe. [Solution] The present invention detects a drone making contact with an obstacle by a combination of an acceleration sensor and a contact detection sensor. If contact is detected, an evacuation action such as hovering is performed. In addition, a message may be displayed, a warning sound generated, a warning light illuminated, etc., on a control terminal. A structure employed as a propeller guard minimizes finger insertion accidents and minimizes interference to the rotor even upon collision.

title: PRECISION CULTIVATOR WITH VISION GUIDANCE
abstract: A method of navigating an agricultural implement through a field in an operative direction as it is being towed by a tractor. The method comprises providing the implement with a main mounting assembly, which is mountable to the tractor and has a stationary main beam, and a toolbar movably supported on the main beam in a lateral position so as to be shiftable laterally relative to the operative direction to align the toolbar relative to crop rows, the toolbar including row units configured to pass between crop rows; obtaining an image of the field with a camera; segmenting the image to identify a plurality of the crop rows extending in the operative direction within a field of vision of the camera; and adjusting the lateral position of the toolbar to maintain the row units between the plurality of crop rows while avoiding damage to the crops.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR OVERLOADING HARVESTED GOODS
abstract: Verfahren zum Überladen von Erntegut von einem Erntefahrzeug auf ein Transportfahrzeug, wobei das Erntefahrzeug eine Vielzahl im Wesentlichen paralleler Fahrspuren abfährt, wobei die Fahrspur des Erntefahrzeugs während der Fahrt aufgezeichnet wird, wobei das Erntefahrzeug während der Fahrt Erntegut aufnimmt, wobei das Transportfahrzeug parallel zum Erntefahrzeug gefahren wird und während der Parallelfahrt von Erntefahrzeug und Transportfahrzeug das Erntegut vom Erntefahrzeug auf das Transportfahrzeug überladen wird, wobei die aufgezeichnete Fahrspur dem Transportfahrzeug übermittelt wird, wobei das Transportfahrzeug im Wesentlichen entlang der übermittelten Fahrspur gefahren wird

title: 'METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR APPLYING A REMEDY FOR A REGION UNDER CULTIVATION'
abstract: Embodiments herein disclose methods and systems for applying a remedy for a region under cultivation including canopy structures, a system includes a controller, a first vehicle and a second vehicle. The controller analyzes a prescription plan for at least one region, wherein the at least one region includes at least one of an over canopy region and an under canopy region. The controller determines a path covering the at least one region identified from the prescription plan using at least one geo-position of the at least one identified region. The controller communicates the determined path to at least one of a first vehicle and a second vehicle. The at least one of the first vehicle and the second vehicle apply the at least one remedy to the at least one of the over canopy region and the under canopy region using the at least one prescription plan.

title: Construction method and structure of ecological ridge
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method and a structure of an ecological ridge. The method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out charge analysis on soil: S1-1, soaking a soil sample in deionized water for 20-28 hours, and removing organic matters in the soil sample with H2O2; preparing the sample into Ca < 2 + > colloid; s1-2, measuring the surface charge by adopting a back titration method; s1-3, carrying out soil charge calculation according to the calculation result; s2, crop straw is selected as a raw material, and hydrophobic biochar is prepared; s3, soil and biochar are fully stirred and mixed to be uniform, and a biochar-soil compound raw material of a core-shell structure is prepared; s4, ditches of 20-30 cm are dug up and down on the basis of the field plane, and the ditches are filled with the biochar-soil compound to construct ecological ridges; the ecological ridge structure comprises a ridge body built in a field and a composite filling layer arranged on the side face of the ridge body.

title: Coal mining collapse crack treatment method based on partition slope terrace mode
abstract: The invention discloses a coal mining collapse crack treatment method based on a partition slope terrace mode; the method adopts the partition slope terrace mode for treatment according to the characteristics of collapse crack development: the crack is subjected to on-site soil sampling and filling, the crack and a soil sampling disturbance area are built into a horizontal terrace in a unified manner, original vegetation is reserved in a non-disturbance area, and a partition slope terrace is formed in a treatment area; and therefore, the runoff of the original slope surface enters the horizontal field surface, the soil moisture is increased to promote crop growth, and the regional ecological reconstruction level is improved.

title: Hidden loading mechanism of intelligent agricultural robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hidden loading mechanism of an intelligent agricultural robot, and relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery, the hidden loading mechanism comprises a chassis assembly, a walking mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a loading mechanism, the lifting mechanism is used for connecting the chassis assembly with the walking mechanism, realizing lifting or lowering of the chassis assembly and driving the chassis assembly to move through the walking mechanism, and the loading mechanism is used for loading the chassis assembly. The loading mechanism is installed at the upper end of the chassis assembly and comprises a driving part, an empty frame hook arm and a full frame hook arm, the empty frame hook arm and the full frame hook arm are symmetrically installed on the driving part, and the driving part is embedded into the upper end of the chassis assembly and can drive the empty frame hook arm and the full frame hook arm to move in the direction close to or away from the harvester. And the full frame hooking arm is used for hooking a full loading frame on the harvester so as to transfer the leafy vegetables, or the empty frame hooking arm is used for hooking an empty loading frame and transporting the empty loading frame to the harvester. According to the hidden loading mechanism of the intelligent agricultural robot, automatic loading and transportation of agricultural products can be achieved, the efficiency is improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title: Spraying type plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a spraying type plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle. The spraying type plant protection unmanned aerialvehicle aims at solving the problems that when an existing plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle is used for spraying crops, liquid pesticide in a pesticide box is not uniform enough due to long-time placement, the spraying range of the liquid pesticide is too small, and the crops are difficult to uniformly spray. According to the scheme, the spraying type plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a vehicle body, vehicle wings are fixedly installed at the four corners of the vehicle body respectively, the tops of the vehicle wings are rotationally connected with wings, two symmetrically-arranged supporting plates are fixedly installed at the bottom of the vehicle body, a placement cavity is formed in the vehicle body, a motor is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the top of the placement cavity, a first rotating rod is fixedly installed on an output shaft of the motor, and a fixing base is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the top of the placement cavity. The spraying type plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle is simple in structure and convenient to use, the liquid pesticide in the pesticide box can be uniformly dispersed during extraction, meanwhile, thespraying range of the liquid pesticide can be enlarged, and people can conveniently use the spraying type plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Spraying system and plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: Provided are a spraying system and a plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle. The plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a vehicle head and a plurality of vehicle arms (16) connected with the vehicle body. A spraying system comprises a liquid storage tank (10), a water distributor (12), a water pump (13), a liquid pipe (14) and a spray head (15); a liquid outlet of theliquid storage tank (10) is connected with a plurality of water pumps (13) through a water segregator (12), a water outlet of each water pump (13) is connected with a plurality of spray heads (15) through a liquid pipe (14), and the spray heads (15) connected with the same water pump (13) are all located on the machine arm (16) on the same side or on the same machine arm (16). According to the spraying system, the spraying width and the whole spraying flow can be effectively increased, calibration and adjustment of the spraying flow of the single-side spray head of the spraying system can beachieved, then the spraying precision and the spraying uniformity are improved, and the requirement for precise spraying operation of the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle is met.

title: Agricultural planting auxiliary robot and automatic operation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an agricultural planting auxiliary robot and an automatic operation method thereof. The robot is in communication connection with a client end and comprises a vehicle body (3),a front end driving mechanism (1) and a rear end driving mechanism (2) for driving the vehicle body, an anti-collision module (5), a high-definition video monitoring and illuminating module (6), a front visual navigation module (7) and a rear visual navigation module (8) arranged on the vehicle body, and a central processing module and a solid battery arranged in the vehicle body. In the robot andthe operation method, the growth process of crops after sowing, such as the growth data index, the environmental data index, the water irrigation situation, the fertilization situation, the situationof whether medication is needed, the disease and insect pest identification, the weed identification and other information, can be collected, recorded, analyzed and judged and water or fertilizer ormedication measures and actions are automatically adopted, and the intelligent automatic management, intelligent delivery and intelligent information acquisition can be realized on the growth of crops, which is suitable for agricultural fine planting.

title: STEERING WHEEL ANGLE CONTROL DEVICE
abstract: A steering wheel angle control device 23 controls, with respect to a steering drive device provided with: a motor that drives an input shaft for inputting a steering wheel angle being a rotation angle, to a steering system of a vehicle, by giving deflection angles to wheels of the vehicle; and an angle sensor that detects the steering wheel angle of the input shaft as a measurement angle, the motor such that the measurement angle tracks a target angle. The steering wheel angle control device 23 is provided with: a measurement angle acquisition unit 232 that acquires the measurement angle detected by the angle sensor; a first determination unit 233a that determines whether or not a deviation angle between the target angle and the measurement angle is approaching to the target angle at or below a threshold value of attenuation having a predetermined angle in the inverse direction from the displacement direction of the input shaft with respect to the target angle; and an angular speed control unit 234 that, when the deviation angle is approaching at or below the threshold value of attenuation, controls the angular speed of the motor on the basis of an attenuation control law for attenuating the angular speed in proportion to the deviation angle.

title: Vehicle manual guidance systems with steering wheel angle sensors and road wheel angle sensors
abstract: A system for providing manual guidance of a vehicle includes a first inertial measurement unit (IMU) attached to a steering wheel, a second IMU attached to a fixed part of the vehicle, a global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) receiver, a data storage device for storing a pre-planned path, and a feedback module. The feedback module is configured to determine a current angle of the steering wheel, determine a deviation of the current position of the vehicle from the pre-planned path, determine a current heading of the vehicle, determine a current velocity of the vehicle, and determine a desired angle of the steering wheel relative to the vehicle. The system further includes a user interface configured to provide a visual indication of the desired angle of the steering wheel or a deviation of the current angle of the steering wheel from the desired angle of the steering wheel.

title: Recharging Station for Agricultural Scattering Drone
abstract: The present invention relates to a charging station of a drone for spraying agricultural pesticides and, more specifically, to a charging station of a drone for spraying agricultural pesticides, which has a charging unit formed in the charging station, correspondingly to a location of a battery in a drone body of the drone for spraying agricultural pesticides, and thus, charging of the battery can be more efficiently performed. According to the present invention, the charging station of a drone for spraying agricultural pesticides comprises: a propeller; a drone body having a control unit, a sensor unit, and a battery formed therein to drive the propeller; an agricultural pesticide tank having a pump disposed on a lower portion of the drone body; a spray nozzle installed in an agricultural pesticide supply pipe connected to the agricultural pesticide tank; the drone for spraying agricultural pesticides, including a support to enable the drone body to safely contact the ground; and a station for charging the battery in the drone body. The station includes: a support plate; first and second rotation threaded rods screwed to first and second fixing members fixed to lower portions of both ends of the support plate; first and second elevating operation pieces screwed to upper portions of the first and second rotation threaded rods and configured to elevate; a charging unit having a charging pad with a coil fixed to inner sides of the first and second elevation operation pieces; and first and second pulleys installed on lower portions of the first and second rotation threaded rods, respectively, wherein a timing belt is installed between the first pulley and a first pulley installed on a shaft of a stationary geared motor and between the second pulley and a second pulley installed on the shaft of a stationary geared motor.

title: VEHICLE-SPEED-INTERLOCKED SPRAY MACHINES WITH CONTROL PART CONNECTED AND CONTROL PART
abstract: To operate a fixed-quantity spraying vehicle-speed-interlocked spray machines as a variable-quantity spraying map-usable spray machine.SOLUTION: Provided is a control part that is directly or indirectly connected to a spray control part of a non-corresponding vehicle-speed-interlocked spray machine and that includes a storage part and a calculation part, wherein the storage part can store variable spray amount map information, the variable spray amount map information including a scheduled spraying amount per area of individual regions of a farm field, the calculation part acquires current position information from information obtained from a GNSS reception part, and acquires spray machine moving speed information from the GNSS reception part. The control part generates pseudo moving speed information necessary for a spraying part to spray in a scheduled spraying amount according to variable spraying amount map information from the position information, the spray machine moving speed information, and a set spraying amount, and sends the pseudo moving speed information to the spray control part of the spray machine as a pseudo spray machine moving speed signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: DATA VISUALIZATION AND ANALYSIS FOR HARVEST STAND COUNTER AND RELATED SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: An agricultural data system comprising at least one stalk sensor disposed on a harvester configured to sense incoming crop stalks, at least one processor in communication with the at least one stalk sensor, and a display in communication with the at least one processor, wherein the processor is configured to align as-planted data with as-harvested data from the at least one stalk sensor.

title: Zonal operator presence detection
abstract: A method for detecting zonal operator presence includes receiving a sensor output from a sensor. The sensor may be located on an agricultural machine and the sensor output indicates an operating state of the agricultural machine. Once the sensor output has been received, the operating state of the agricultural machine is determined based on the sensor output. The operating state includes an operator being located within a work area of the agricultural machine. The work area is divided into a plurality of zones. An operating parameter is adjusted based on the operating state.

title: Closing Wheel Downforce Adjustment Devices, Systems, And Methods
abstract: The disclosed devices, systems and methods relate to an adaptive closing system for seed trench closing. The adaptive closing system including at least one row unit and a closing unit. The closing unit including at least one closing disc and an actuator. The adaptive closing system constructed and arranged to receive closing force inputs and generate closing force outputs to dynamically adjust the amount of downforce applied to the closing discs.

title: Variable rate application system for dispersal of material from an aircraft
abstract: Disclosed is a method of precision farming application of a material using a variable rate application system suitable for use in aerial topdressing. The method includes the steps of: acquiring data over an area to be treated by aerial dispersion of the material; analysing the acquired data to determine a measure of land quality at each location within the area; converting the measure of land quality at each location into a prescription map file containing the amounts of the material to be dispersed at each location throughout the area to be treated; and dispersing the material from an aircraft-mounted system adapted for variable rate dispersal of the material from a hopper. The rate of dispersion is controlled by varying an opening in the hopper in accord with the prescription map file and the flying conditions at each location. A controller for a variable flow rate hopper is also disclosed.

title: REMOTE OPERATION DEVICE FOR PARALLEL TRAVEL WORK SYSTEM
abstract: [Problem] To enable the displaying, at the display of a remote operation device, of information such as the travel state and work state of an autonomous travel work vehicle, thus enabling the easy apprehending of the state of the autonomous travel work vehicle. [Solution] In a parallel travel work system, an autonomous travel work vehicle (1), which is provided with a position calculation means that measures the device body position by means of a satellite positioning system, a steering actuator (40) that operates a steering device, an engine rotation control means, a transmission means (44), and a control device (30) that controls each of same, is caused to autonomously travel along a set travel path stored in the control device (30) by an accompanying travel work vehicle (100) that works while accompanying the travel of the autonomous travel work vehicle (1) by means of attended operation and that is mounted with a remote operation device (112) that can operate the autonomous travel work vehicle (1). The remote operation device (112) is portable and is removably attached to the accompanying travel work vehicle (100), and the travel state, engine state, and work machine state of the autonomous travel work vehicle (1) can be displayed at a display (113) provided to the remote operation device (112).

title: COMBINE
abstract: To provide a combine capable of reaping five or more rows, and acquiring information indicating a range of entry of reaped crops on a reaping part in a reaping width direction.SOLUTION: A combine comprises: three transport devices 19R, 19C, 19L which are arranged in a reaping width direction of a reaping part 6A, and transport reaped crops to a rear confluence part 20. There are provided a plurality of crop detection sensors S1, S2, S3 each of which is provided on one of respective transport paths 23R, 25R, 27R of the three transport devices 19R, 19C, 19L and detects existence of crops on the transport paths 23R, 25R, 27R. There is provided a reaping state detection part for calculating a range of entry of reaped crops on the reaping part 6A in the reaping width direction, on the basis of detection results of the crop detection sensors S1, S2, S3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Field variable rate fertilization device and variable rate fertilization control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural production, and provides a field variable rate fertilization device and a variable rate fertilization control method. The field variable rate fertilization device comprises a conductivity detection device, a speed measurement device, a traction machine tool, a control device and a fertilization machine tool, the conductivity detection device is arranged at the front end of the traction machine tool, and the fertilizing machine tool is arranged at the rear end of the traction machine tool; the conductivity detection device and the speed measurement device are respectively connected with the control device, and the control device is connected with the fertilizer applicator. The fertilizer can be applied as required according to the soil fertility requirements of different areas of the field, the utilization rate of the fertilizer can be increased, the application cost of the fertilizer is reduced, and the pollution to the environment is reduced.

title: System and method for measuring soil conductivity using existing farm implements
abstract: A system for measuring soil properties on-the-go uses soil-engaging components of an existing farm implement as electrodes for a soil conductivity measurement system. The soil-engaging components can be: electrically isolated shanks and/or replaceable points or sweeps on a tillage implement; a row cleaner or coulter device on the front of a planter row unit, the closing wheels on the back of the planter row unit, or an entire planter row unit; or an additional soil contacting component added to an existing implement shank. A soil engaging component serving as an electrode is electrically isolated from other components of the implement.
