A soil conductivity measurement is made by passing current between a first pair of soil-engaging electrodes and measuring voltage resulting from the current between a second pair of soil-engaging electrodes. A narrow profile sensor unit can be attached to the implement to measure additional soil properties.

title: Automatic coconut picking device based on drone
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic coconut picking device based on a drone, and belongs to the field of drones and agricultural robots. According to the device, a micro laser cutting machine and abarb dart emitter are mounted on the drone, the micro laser cutting machine and the barb dart emitter are carried near mature coconuts through the drone, the barb dart emitter emits barb darts connected with the drone to the coconuts, after the barb darts are inserted into coconut shells, the micro laser cutting machine carries out laser cutting on coconut pedicel of the coconuts locked by the barb darts, and the coconuts separated from coconut trees are suspended below the drone through the barb darts. In order to guarantee implementation of the functions of the device, a camera for locking the mature coconuts, a wireless communication device for information exchange and a single-chip microcomputer for controlling the device are further mounted on the drone. The device can continuously pick the coconuts, the quality of the coconuts is guaranteed while the workload is reduced, and the device is superior to existing coconut picking devices and technologies.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR MEASURING VEGETATION COVER ON FARMLAND
abstract: The invention relates to a method for measuring vegetation cover in which by means of an image sensor, translated at least in a direction above said land to be analysed, several images of a portion of said land are acquired. Each image is in turn sub-divided into several sectors for which a vegetation cover index is calculated based on the chromatic components of the pixels. Monitoring the position of the sensor by means of a GPS system and knowing the geometrical parameters of the image, the position on the land of the various areas to which the sectors of each image correspond is calculated. For a given number of sectors whose areas on the ground are sufficiently overlapped, the cover indices previously calculated are compared and a correct cover index of the corresponding area on the land is determined. The invention also relates to a device configured to implement the aforesaid method.

title: SYSTEM FOR SYNCHRONIZING AGRICULTURAL EQUIPMENT OR MACHINES
abstract: The present invention relates to a synchronization system used in agricultural implements or machines, the aim of which is to synchronize the operation of more than one agricultural machine or implement such that they work simultaneously in a field through the transmission of operating data via radio-frequency.

title: Mapping field anomalies using digital images and machine learning models
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating an improved map of field anomalies using digital images and machine learning models is disclosed. In an embodiment, a method comprises: obtaining a shapefile that defines boundaries of an agricultural plot and boundaries of the field containing the plot; obtaining a plurality of plot images within the field from one or more image capturing devices that are located within the boundaries of the field; calibrating and pre-processing the plurality of plot images to create a plot map of the agricultural plot at a plot level; based on the plot map of the agricultural plot, generating a plot grid; based on the plot grid and the plot map, generating a plurality of plot tiles; based on the plurality of plot tiles, generating, using a first machine learning model and a plurality of first image classifiers corresponding to one or more first anomalies, a set of classified plot images that depicts at least one anomaly; based on the set of classified plot images, generating a plot anomaly map for the agricultural plot; transmitting the plot anomaly map to one or more controllers that control one or more agricultural machines or database systems to perform agricultural functions on the agricultural plot.

title: GRAIN TRUCK FILL DETECTION
abstract: A system is provided for controlling a grain cart relative to a grain truck. The grain cart includes a grain tank and an unload auger configured to transfer crop material out of the grain tank. The grain truck includes a truck box extending from a first end to a second end. The truck box includes a top edge extending around the top of the truck box. The system comprises a ranging device and a controller. The ranging device is configured to identify a distance to the top edge of the truck box and identify a distance to an area in the truck box. The controller is configured to determine a position of the grain cart relative to the grain truck, and determine whether the grain cart is positioned near the first end of the truck box. If the controller determines that the grain cart is positioned near the first end of the truck box, the controller is configured to determine a fill level in the area based on the distance to the top edge of the truck box and the distance to the area in the truck box, determine whether the fill level exceeds a threshold, and if the controller determines that the fill level does not exceed the threshold, the controller is configured to start the unload auger.

title: Aerator with hole spacing control system
abstract: An aerator with a hole spacing control system is disclosed. The aerator has a traction drive with at least a pair of driven wheels and a single steered wheel. A vehicle control unit provides commands to the traction drive to move the aerator at a specified ground speed. An operator-adjustable hole spacing actuator may be moved to a plurality of hole spacing settings. The hole spacing actuator is electrically connected to the vehicle control unit. The vehicle control unit includes logic to vary the commands to the traction drive based on the hole spacing settings from the actuator. An engine speed sensor and/or coring head speed sensor also may be electrically connected to the vehicle control unit, and the vehicle control unit commands being also based on inputs from those speed sensors.

title: TEACHER DATA GENERATION DEVICE, TEACHER DATA GENERATION METHOD, AND AGRICULTURAL HARVESTER
abstract: To provide a teacher data generation device, a teacher data generation method, and an agricultural harvester having these inventions mounted thereon that can efficiently generate teacher data used in generating a learned model for determining whether harvesting can be carried out in the operation of a harvesting robot.SOLUTION: A teacher data generation device comprises: an imaging device that picks up an image of harvest to be harvested, and transmits image data to a data processing unit; a fixing unit that fixes the harvest to a predetermined position; and a detector that detects the state of fixation of the harvest fixed by the fixing unit, and transmits detection data to the data processing unit. The data processing unit generates harvest information indicating whether the harvest has been harvested based on the detection data and associates it with the image data, and stores the image data and harvest information in a teacher data storage unit as teacher data for machine learning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Drone pesticide spraying device
abstract: The invention discloses a drone pesticide spraying device, and relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture tools. A pesticide box is installed at the front end of a drone body, and a connecting pesticide inlet nozzle is installed on a pesticide inlet; the pesticide box is located in the middle of the drone body, a stirring motor is installed in the middle of the upper end of the pesticide box, a plurality of transverse stirring rods are symmetrically installed on a rotating shaft of the stirring motor, and inclined stirring rods are installed on the two side walls of each transverse stirring rod; a double-pump pesticide spraying mechanism is installed on the side wall of the pesticide box, a pesticide inlet pipe of the double-pump pesticide spraying mechanism is arranged in the pesticide box, a pesticide outlet pipe of the double-pump pesticide spraying mechanism is connected with a pesticide spraying pipe, and the pesticide spraying pipe is installed at the bottom of thepesticide box through a lifting mechanism; an electric box is installed at the front end of the drone body; an anti-collision plate is installed at the front end of the drone body through a damping shaft, and a plurality of detection sensors are installed on the inner front side wall of the anti-collision plate. By means of the drone pesticide spraying device, automatic detection type pesticide spraying can be achieved, automatic control over pesticide spraying can be achieved, pesticide spraying and controlling time can be shortened, operation is simple and convenient, and efficiency is high.

title: PLANT NUTRIENT COMPOSITION AND A PROCESS FOR MANUFACTURING OF THE SAME BY INCORPORATION
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of agriculture in particular this invention pertains to development of plant nutrient related to precision agriculture. The invention relates to a plant nutrient composition comprising as first component a nitrogenous, phosphorus or NPK complex fertilizer and as second component humic acid, boric acid, salts of Zn, Cu, Mn, Mg or combination thereof, wherein the ratio of the first component to the second component is in the range of 10: 0.05 to 10: 3. In preferred embodiments the fertiliser is urea or diammonium phosphate and the second component is humic acid, boric acid, fulvic acid, cupric sulphate, zinc sulphate or combination thereof. The first component is optionally treated with castor oil, glycerol or vegetable oil. This plant nutrient is useful for enhancement of significant crop yield.

title: Hyperspectral image classification method based on image regular low-rank expression dimensionality reduction
abstract: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image classification method based on image regular low-rank expression dimensionality reduction. The method includes the steps that a mean shift technology is used for conducting pre-segmentation on a hyperspectral image first, image regular low-rank coefficient expression is conduced on the hyperspectral image after pre-segmentation to obtain an image regular low-rank coefficient matrix, a characteristic value equation is constructed, a mapping matrix of the dimensionality reduction is studied, and original high dimensional data are transformed to low-dimensional space to be further classified. According to the hyperspectral image classification method, a hyperspectral image local manifold structure is excavated, the spatial distribution character of an original image is kept, effective dimensionality reduction space is studied, the classification accuracy of hyperspectral images is improved, computation complexity is lowered, the problems that the dimensionality of the hyperspectral image is too high so that the calculation amount can be large, and an existing method is low in classification accuracy are mainly solved, and the hyperspectral image classification method can be used for important fields such as precision agriculture, object identification and environment monitor.

title: Machine vision plant tracking system for precision agriculture
abstract: An illustrative control system for a precision agricultural implement includes a controller having a convolutional neural network, an imaging device, a plurality of sensors, and a plurality of actuators in communication with the controller, the controller configured for detecting and tracking objects of interest in a commodity field, such a commodity plants, and the plurality of actuators including a plurality of agricultural tool actuators the controller operates based on the detection and tracking of object of interest in the commodity field.

title: AUTOMATIC OPERATION SYSTEM
abstract: To save a working preparatory time for automatic operation.SOLUTION: An automatic operation system comprises: a server 110 storing reference path information on at least a reference path in a field; an external GPS 300a and a built-in GPS 300b measuring a position of a tractor 200; and an automatic operation control part 220 mounted on the tractor 200 for controlling automatic operation of the tractor 200 in the field on the basis of the reference path information stored in the server 110 and information of the measured position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PHENOTYPIC CHARACTERISATION OF AGRICULTURAL CROPS
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for phenotypic characterisation of agricultural crops, which comprises at least one support device that can be autonomously configured or remotely controlled, which includes a central embedded microcontroller connected to atmospheric sensors disposed on an upper body, and a microcontroller connected to a multispectral chamber arranged at the distal end of an arm, wherein the central microcontroller is connected to a base microcontroller that acquires signal from sensors on the ground, the microcontrollers obtaining energy from a regulating unit powered by a solar panel. The system contains a communication unit that includes a router wirelessly connected to the Internet.

title: Rudder-assisted steering for self-propelled drainage equipment
abstract: Novel tools and techniques for performing steering operations for a tracked vehicle with a dragged implement using a control system that uses a combination of differential steering and rudder steering based on one or more operating conditions of the vehicle.

title: Intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle system for spraying pesticides and fertilizers and control method realizing the automation of pesticide and fertilizer spraying to replace manpower
abstract: This invention discloses an intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle system for spraying pesticides and fertilizers and a control method. The intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a wireless communication module and a flight control module. The flight control module comprises a spraying voyage setting module and an actual spraying flight control module. The spraying voyage setting module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to perform voyage planning and flight setting of spraying pesticide and fertilizer to ensure that the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to the upside of a to-be-sprayed farmland region according to a preset height, speed and route sequence so as to obtain a plurality of corner points and record the serial parameter, height parameter and coordinate parameters of each corner point and the parameter of time that the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches the corner point, wherein the corner points which are twinned together into pairs are connected into a straight line serving as a spraying line, and the aerial vehicle is enabled to perform actual spraying flight along the spraying line, so that the aim of realizing the automation of pesticide and fertilizer spraying to replace manpower can be achieved.

title: MAP GENERATION SYSTEM AND MAP GENERATION METHOD
abstract: This map generation system generates map data for an agricultural machine that travels autonomously on a road around a field. The map generation system comprises: a storage device for storing a plurality of geographical feature block images associated with each of a plurality of types of geographical features that can exist around the road; and a processing device. The processing device performs the following: acquires position distribution data relating to one or more types of geographical features present around the road, said position distribution data being generated on the basis of at least one of image data from an imaging device and sensor data from a LiDAR sensor output while a moving body equipped with at least one of the LiDAR sensor and the imaging device moves along the road; reads one or more types of geographical block images associated with the one or more types of geographical features from the storage device; and arranges the geographical feature block images in accordance with the position distribution data and generates map data of an area including the road.

title: AUTOMATIC LAWN MOWER AND PATH PLANNING METHOD, SYSTEM, AND DEVICE THEREOF
abstract: A robotic mower and a path planning method, system and device are provided and the method includes controlling the robotic mower to exit a charging station, controlling the robotic mower to find a boundary wire or guide wire, where the boundary wire is pre-laid on the edge of the working area of the robotic mower, and the guidance line is pre-laid in the working area of the robotic mower, controlling the robotic mower to follow the boundary wire or guide wire to move until it reaches the predetermined position. With the disclosure, tracks generated when the robotic mower exit the charging station along a fixed path can be avoided, and the damage to the lawn or vegetation can be reduced.

title: Self-propelled high-ground clearance fertilizing amount-variable fertilizer spreader
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural equipment and relates to a self-propelled high-ground clearance fertilizing amount-variable fertilizer spreader. The fertilizer spreader is characterized in that the self-propelled high-ground clearance fertilizing amount-variable fertilizer spreader mainly comprises an engine and an oil pump (2), a cab (2), a display (3), a high-ground clearance chassis (4), a controller and a control system (5), a GPS transmitting-receiving system (6), a connection suspension support assembly (7), a hydraulic lifting-up system (8), a fertilizer spreader assembly (9), a fertilizer tank and a fertilizer outlet (10), a fertilizer spreader disc (11), a gear driving device (12), a hydraulic driving system (13), a support (14), road wheels and a velocity measurement sensor (15), and a stepping motor and a fertilizer outlet adjustment device (16). The lower end of the connection suspension support assembly (7) is provided with the hydraulic lifting-up system (8). The self-propelled high-ground clearance fertilizing amount-variable fertilizer spreader realizes accurate and sensitive adjustment of a fertilizing amount, realizes broad-width high-efficiency fertilizer spreading and has the whole work performances satisfying requirements on high-efficiency fertilizing amount-variable fertilizer spreading in a paddy field.

title: Beidou positioning technology-based soil moisture condition distribution automatic monitoring system
abstract: A Beidou positioning technology-based soil moisture condition distribution automatic monitoring system includes soil moisture condition monitoring terminals having a Beidou positioning function, a wireless Ad Hoc network, a mobile gateway and a data analysis center platform; any two soil moisture condition monitoring terminals communicate through the wireless Ad Hoc network, the wireless Ad Hoc network transmits data to the mobile gateway, the mobile gateway remotely uploads the data to the data analysis center platform through a mobile communication network such as 3G/4G or the Internet, and in the data analysis center platform, data of sampling points are converted into a point bitmap of sampling points, and spatial interpolation is performed on the data of each sampling point, thereby forming collected data distribution diagrams such as a soil moisture distribution diagram, a pH value distribution diagram and a soil nutrient distribution diagram, and realizing automatic monitoring and management of precision agriculture.

title: Crop Dusting Drones
abstract: The present invention relates to a drone for a pest control and, more specifically, to a drone for a pest control, including a spray nozzle which can spray agricultural pesticides and fertilizers in the vertical direction in accordance with an assembly condition to perform pest control work by spraying the agricultural pesticides and the fertilizers to a farmland. According to the present invention, the drone for a pest control can improve work efficiency by spraying the agricultural pesticides to various positions by spraying the spray nozzle which is one of components of a spray unit in both upper and lower directions in accordance with the assembly by a user and controlling a spray angle in accordance with the pressure. Also, the drone for a pest control has a structure in which the spray unit is connected to a spray hose. Therefore, the drone for a pest control smoothly performs agricultural pesticide spraying work without being hung between trees when spraying the agricultural pesticides between the trees. So, the drone for a pest control can spray the agricultural pesticide by using the drone even if a worker does not manually spray the agricultural pesticides.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To easily execute automatic steering in backward traveling.SOLUTION: A work vehicle includes: a vehicle body that can travel either by manual steering with a steering wheel or by automatic steering of the steering wheel; a reference registration unit for registering a traveling reference line on the basis of a position of the vehicle body that travels by manual steering; an automatic steering control unit for executing control of automatic steering in a planned traveling line set on the basis of the traveling reference line; a display device for displaying information on automatic steering when the automatic steering is for forward traveling; and a notification device for notifying of the information on the automatic steering in addition to the display device when the automatic steering is for backward traveling.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Sowing machine and agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: A sowing machine includes a motor (11), a speed reduction mechanism (13), a stirring mechanism (14), and a material sowing mechanism (15). The stirring mechanism (14) is arranged above a discharge port of the material sowing mechanism (15) and used for stirring materials. The speed reduction mechanism (13) comprises: an input terminal, a first output shaft (131) and a second output shaft (132), wherein the input terminal is connected to an output shaft of the motor (11), so that the output shaft of the motor (11) drives the input terminal to rotate. The first output shaft (131) is fixed to the stirring mechanism (14) for driving the stirring mechanism (14) to rotate at a first rotational speed. The second output shaft (132) is fixed to the material sowing mechanism (15) for driving the material sowing mechanism (15) to rotate at a second rotational speed. The sowing machine (10) provided in the invention drives the stirring mechanism (14) and the material sowing mechanism (15) to rotate at the same time by the speed reduction mechanism (13), thereby simplifying the structure and improving the energy efficiency. The invention also provides an agricultural unmanned aerial vehicle.
